items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I played the Trianon with Duke and them that night.

ctx.x: I said, "I don't care. I may not ever get a chance to play with Duke in my life, and I'm not gonna give this up." You know, and I signed the contract with the man, but Billy Berg, you know, he was very fond of me, you know - he had to be, because he says, "You've got to be the craziest man in the world. How can you be the leader of the band and you're not gonna make your opening?" And I said, "There's no need talking about it; I'm going to go play with Duke tonight." I always wanted to know how he started the…

You know how you start playing the piano, and all of a sudden, here comes the band - BANG, you know, and that was always a mystery to me, that I wanted solved. And so I said, "I'm gonna go play with him." And I left him, and I left him and I played the Trianon with Duke and them that night. Luckily, when I came back the next night, I still had a job, but you know, it was only because the man liked me. Because, you know, that was a little far out.
Yeah. Did you find out how Duke started the band?
